content: When receiving a request for OBD Service $04, the Dcm module shall call the interface Dem_SelectDTC with the following parameter values: • ClientId: Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef ) • DTC = DEM_DTC_GROUP_ALL_DTCS • DTCFormat = DEM_DTC_FORMAT_OBD • DTCOrigin = DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_OBD_RELEVANT_MEMORY
